notes.title: Announcing Remastered Version of Insurgence 1 & 2
notes.content:
Platomenti Studios and YSY Softworks partnered with CRX Entertainment Pte Ltd are pleased to announce the upcoming release of the Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault.

The Remastered version of these two games is set to feature a brand new pixel rendering engine, providing players with even more vibrant and rich colors than ever before, bringing these games to life in a whole new way. In addition, the games will be localized to more languages, with more details on which languages to come soon.

For Insurgence - Chains of Renegade, the game will also feature all new music from SSCore, a music production studio from YSY Softworks. This in-house music production studio has collaborated with Platomenti Studios for this release, providing an entirely new soundtrack for players to enjoy as they progress through the game.

"We're thrilled to bring these two beloved games back to the forefront with the Remastered version," said a spokesperson for Platomenti Studios. "With the new pixel rendering engine and the addition of more languages, we're confident that players will love the new look and feel of the game. And with the all-new music from SSCore, we're confident that both new and returning players will have an unforgettable experience."

The Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault will be available on PC, with a Steam release planned for the near future. The Steam page is now up for Wishlist, so fans of the series can show their support and stay up-to-date with the latest news on the upcoming release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327370/Insurgence__Chains_of_Renegade_Remastered/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327380/Insurgence__Second_Assault_Remastered/


For more information on the Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault, please visit the official website of Platomenti Studios or follow their social media pages.

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41242823/82285765da658797a9aa99b5a989c34a98c080bf.png[/img]

We are really happy to announcing the first arc of our game [b]FRAGMENTED MEMORIES[/b] will be released on Steam on 22 April 2022.

We know some of you may ask, why Arc One? there's gonna be Arc Two? is this unfinished game? and many other questions.

We try to answer some of those questions here.

Q: Why splitting the game into multiple/two Arc?
A: We decide to split the game into two Arc, the First Arc and Second Arc, we did this because we don't want sacrifice the quality of the game in the name of longer gameplay.

Second, we did revise the storyline in the middle of development and decide to make the story longer , more complex and adding more twist and so on, In the end I really hope player can enjoy the first Arc and wish for the second Arc to be released soon.

Q: How long is the Gameplay?
A: The First Arc will give you around 3 Hours of Gameplay Time, Maybe less than 2 if you are "speedrunning" type of player who already know all the puzzle and stuff.

Q: When you gonna release the Second Arc?
A: We plan it release the second arc on Q3 this year.

Q: How much the game will cost when release?
A: We can't disclose the price before release due to Steam Agreement, but definitely will much less than our other games (including other YSY Softworks title) since we decide to split this game into multiple arc.

That's for now. I really hope you guys will enjoy our games!

notes.title: New Project Announced! FRAGMENTED MEMORIES
notes.content:
Introducing our new Project, [b]Fragmented Memories[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41242823/32d8a1b57be9b2c6f5531485542f4cd263a031e1.jpg[/img]

[b]Story[/b]

James Charouz, a mine worker decided to return to his hometown, Mayoni Village. He found out that his wife is missing and tried to find her. Strangely, nobody knows about his wife. James suspected that the villagers sacrificed his wife in an occult ritual. He was assisted by a senior detective named Pieter Van Amersfoort in order to find her. 

During his search for his wife, James also finds himself trapped in an unknown world. James began to find mysterious things that made him question everything: his memories, his friends, even his sanity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41242823/937bdfdb1f68a0fa6dc533ac874ca4bca8790c64.jpg[/img]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[i][b]Explore[/b][/i]
Explore the "[i]Unknown world[/i]" and find your way to the exit, Solve the Puzzles inside the unknown world.

[i][b]Investigate[/b][/i]
On the "[i]Real World"[/i], Investigate and try to find a clue about your wife, Ask the villagers, explore the village and uncover the truth behind it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41242823/fcb998819e4dab3995c3bfa357f7c43b1dd1424b.jpg[/img]

[b]Other Features[/b]

[list]
[*] 8 Tracks of Original Music from YSY FIRTSOUND, Explore the unknown world and investigate the village with our beautifully composed original music.
[*] 1080p Full HD Graphics, Enjoy High Resolution 1080p Resolution Graphics, Sharp CG Images, Sharp Text and Beautiful Pixel Art.
[*] Hand-painted Digital Art CG from Veteran Indonesian Comic Artist Gear.Azre 
[*] Interactive Icons that tell the player which object can be interacted with and which one is not.
[/list]

Please Follow & Add our game to your Wishlist! And wish us luck! We will keep you posted with the development update on this steam page!
